image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a dark, textured rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping, pale greenish-white calcareous plates embedded in a rough, brownish, leathery girdle.
